- **Sarah** — Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30 (was mis-sent as Tue 11:00 — correction sent)

Calendar updated: Monday freed up again, Wednesday 13:00–13:30 now has Advisor 1:1, and the log records the deleted Monday slot and the new booking.

Settled: he withdrew the 11:00 time (it was a mistake on his side) and confirmed **Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30**. Nothing was booked at 11:00, so no lunch was moved — and I won't book that slot without asking you.

Glad it lined up. Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30 it is — I'll flag anything the Professor sends before then.
